title: governance: agent-instruction files are human-merge only — AGENTS.md carries the governed-surface rule
body:
Maintainer ruling (2026-08-18, PM chat, objectstack skills-seat session `session_01Rn7aaamsR99FXRqLcpL99q`). The maintainer asked whether edits to AGENTS.md-class files need human review **including in the objectui and cloud repos** (「任何对 agents.md 等文件的修改是不是也需要人类审核？ 包括 objectui cloud仓库」) and approved the seat's recommendation verbatim: 「同意」.

**Named reader**: the `repo:objectui` execution seat — this card is the cross-repo replication half of objectstack#9495 and lands here (file-at-destination).

## What to land (this repo's AGENTS.md, one rule block)

1. **Governed surface** for this repo: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/**` (agents, hooks, skills, settings — all of it), plus `docs/adr/**` if/where it exists here.
2. **Hard rule**: agent seats never flip ready, never enqueue, and never arm auto-merge on a PR whose diff touches the governed surface — such PRs stay **draft, awaiting a human merge**; the human's merge action IS the review record (per the objectstack#9495 model: no per-PR approval click required).
3. **Mixed diff**: one governed path in the diff forks the whole PR to human-merge — no proportionality judgment.
4. Keep the wording durable (the maintainer's standing criterion: transient/transition-window facts do not enter instruction files).

Audit tooling note: the report-only governed-merges audit ships first for objectstack only (objectstack#9495); this repo relies on the rule text + seat discipline until a cross-repo audit follow-up exists — state that plainly in the rule block rather than implying tooling that isn't there.

The implementing PR is itself governed by the rule it lands: draft, human merge.
